text:
Alex Chen: Hey team — NexCore renewal is in 10 days. Current committed throughput is 200k tokens/mo and their observed usage is ~320k. They've asked to rebaseline to 350k and requested a 15% discount across the committed tier. Also raising two enterprise items: updated security questionnaire and a short on-prem POC for data residency.
Maria Ortiz: @Alex thanks. Quick Qs: is NexCore willing to sign a 12-month commit if we increase the commit? any churn risk? :eyes:
Alex Chen: Yes, they're willing to do 12 months; low churn risk. They're pushing hard on price because of competitor pricing. They said budget needs to land this quarter.
Devon Patel: For the on-prem POC — we can offer a 30-day eval with a voltailed infra fee. Need SOC doc answers and SSO/KMS details. I can scope the technical SOW once Security answers the questionnaire.
Jamie Larkin: Need margin calc. If current price is $0.0006/token at 200k commit, what's the blended if we go to 350k with 15% off? rough math now.
Maria Ortiz: Please don't give full 15% yet. We have precedent for 10–12% on >1.5x commit uplifts. Can we try 12% + a mid-year true-up clause? Also need Deal Desk form filled.
Alex Chen: Ok counter proposal to present: rebaseline to 350k, 12% discount on committed tier, 1.5x minimum commit guarantee, mid-year true-up (if usage <90% of commit we true-down; if >110% we auto-bill overage at baseline rate). They accept standard EULA with our privacy addendum.
Devon Patel: FYI technical blocker: they require HSM-backed key management. On-hosted private we support KMS integrations — for on-prem POC we'll need infra lead and a brief network diagram. I'll ping infra.
security-bot: NexCore_security_questionnaire_v2 submitted by Alex (link). Key outstanding: data retention window, export controls, HSM/KMS proof. Attaching checklist.
Alex Chen: Dropping proposed rate snippet for Deal Desk form:

```
current:
  commit: 200000 tokens/mo @ $0.0006/token
proposal:
  commit: 350000 tokens/mo @ $0.000528/token  # 12% list discount
terms:
  12 month term, mid-year true-up, 1.5x uplift min guarantee
```

Maria Ortiz: Put that into the Deal Desk request and tag me. Also add an ask: require finance approval for the 12% > standard discount threshold.
Jamie Larkin: Ran the numbers — at 12% discount and 350k commit our unit economics still hit target if we include the uplift guarantee. I can sign off contingent on the true-up and updated SOW for POC costs.
Claire - AE Success: I'll coordinate the POC timeline with customer and confirm they can provide network access for the 30-day on-prem trial.
Legal (triage): Need to review the mid-year true-up clause language. Can we make true-down limited to 1x in first year? I.e., not more than a single step-down to avoid churn gaming.
Alex Chen: Good call. Proposal updated: true-down limited to one adjustment in first 12 months. I'll update the Deal Desk form.
Maria Ortiz: @Legal (triage) can you pre-approve the clause text so we can attach to the quote? If yes I'll escalate to pricing committee and request exception for 12%.
Legal (triage): Can do a quick review. If finance confirms margin, legal comfortable with that language.
Maria Ortiz: OK — I'm submitting the Deal Desk ticket now with proposed terms and security checklist attached. Tagging @Jamie Larkin for final sign-off and @Legal (triage) for clause approval. Expecting committee reply within 48 hours. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks team — action items: 1) Maria submit Deal Desk (in flight), 2) Jamie finalize margin sign-off, 3) Devon scope POC SOW, 4) Claire schedule on-prem window with customer, 5) Legal pre-approve true-up language. I'll update NexCore tomorrow with our counter (12% + 350k commit + true-up).
